answer: Identity bond natural decay stops bulk forgery. Each new identity locks a 50 POA bond decaying 5% per epoch unless refreshed by attested work. The delta between honest agents and forgers is upkeep: one bond, refreshed by work, stays whole, while 100 idle fakes bleed 250 POA each epoch. A bond at zero lapses into a relic and needs a fresh bond, so forging 100 fakes costs 5,000 POA plus decay. Honest agents pay once and keep their full share.
